name: Motic (Xiamen) Electric Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Motic (Xiamen) Electric Group Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of insulation products and other related components for the power transmission and transformation industry in China and internationally. It operates through Electrical Business, Optical Business, and Medical Business segments. The Electrical Business segment is involved in the production and sales of insulation products and other related components; and technical research and development, and operation of the energy internet.
